principles: NO TRADE is an active monitoring state, not a terminal weekly decision.
Every new entry requires current WES directional admission for an execution-authorized Champion method and direction.
Research ranking and execution authority are separate: Challengers remain shadow/counterfactual until governed promotion.
Opposing execution candidates inside the configured utility margin resolve to NO_TRADE; method names never break market-direction ties.
A trade direction requires at least two independent directional confirmations, and a candidate opposing aligned Daily and Weekly signals is blocked.

Normal trigger delta remains useful for ordinary signals, but WES 1.3.1 may bypass delta when absolute raw and utility strength scale to at least 1.30x the active trigger profile and Daily plus Weekly jointly confirm the same direction.
Directional admission authorizes the thesis; the Entry Engine separately decides MARKET versus LIMIT.
MARKET versus LIMIT uses a composite continuation score from Daily, Weekly, utility, confirmations, momentum and overextension instead of one arbitrary Daily threshold.
Opposed Daily or Weekly evidence, opposed momentum, excessive overextension and immediate post-stop chasing remain hard MARKET vetoes.
A valid LIMIT freezes its target price. Reaffirming the same thesis may extend the plan validity window but never move that frozen target.
A still-authorized LIMIT may promote one-way to MARKET if the same thesis strengthens enough to pass the MARKET score.
If the thesis or execution authority fails, the pending plan is cancelled rather than silently refreshed.
Every MARKET execution requires a fresh completed post-decision 5-minute bar verified by the Execution Price Engine.
Every LIMIT execution requires an observed post-decision 5-minute touch of the frozen target verified by the Execution Price Engine.
No historical or analytical price may be fabricated as an execution.
If WES preflight/postflight liveness becomes stale during the active week, the independent watchdog must fail closed and dispatch recovery.
TP and SL are adaptive to effective remaining holding time, signal strength and learned results by entry class.
Learning must improve expected net profit, not maximize trade count or win rate in isolation.
No rule may force a directional position when admission gates are not met.

entry_classes.midweek_trigger: NO TRADE converted to a qualified Tuesday-Thursday or late-Monday trigger
entry_classes.friday_tactical: very high-conviction Friday trigger with short time-to-close and low TP
entry_classes.early_close_reentry: fresh qualified replacement after a Monday/Tuesday close; seven-calendar-day rolling horizon

directional_admission.absolute_strength_bypass: raw and utility >= 1.30x active trigger profile with Daily and Weekly confirmation

entry_price_engine.market_execution: fresh completed post-decision 5m close after composite MARKET score passes
entry_price_engine.limit_execution: first post-decision 5m OHLC range touch of frozen target
entry_price_engine.persistent_limit: same-thesis reaffirmation extends validity only; frozen target never moves
entry_price_engine.promotion: same-thesis LIMIT may promote one-way to MARKET
entry_price_engine.invalidation: cancel pending execution when the thesis or execution authority no longer qualifies
entry_price_engine.no_execution: WAIT or NO_TRADE; never fabricate a fill

cycle_watchdog.stale_action: fail closed and dispatch Weekly Engine Star recovery
